name: prometheus
description: Role-based delivery OS on Herdr. Say 'begin' in the seat to start a dispatcher that watches Shortcut and GitHub, matches events to unit workspaces by story or PR stack, auto-creates review units and proposes the rest; each unit's project manager leads the full vertical, opening named implementor and reviewer tabs and running a background librarian that records finalized decisions in the knowledge base. Self-contained: procedure skills and the project registry ship in the plugin.
